data.name: 捉鸡
data.detailed_description:
Catch Chick is a relaxing yet challenging multiplayer platforming adventure. The chickens have escaped — team up with your friends and set out on a journey to catch them all!

In the game, you will jump, climb, and dodge obstacles while finding your way through increasingly higher levels. Take on the challenge alone, or play online with friends. A single mistake may send you falling from great heights, but every retry brings you one step closer to reaching the finish line.

Game Features

  • Platforming gameplay focused on jumping and climbing

  • Online multiplayer support — challenge the levels together with friends

  • A charming cartoon style with a fun and casual atmosphere

  • Levels filled with obstacles, platforms, and collectible goals

  • Keep trying after failure and challenge yourself to climb higher

Catch the Escaped Chickens

Climb upward, overcome platforms and obstacles, and collect the escaped chickens along the way. With simple objectives, changing routes, and hilarious moments created by falling and retrying with friends, every run becomes a fun and memorable adventure.

data.short_description: Catch Chick is a fun 3D platforming adventure where players jump across floating sky platforms, chase escaped chickens, and climb toward the crown at the top. Play solo or with friends online, overcome obstacles, collect chickens, and enjoy hilarious moments on every climb.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB or AMD RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700 or AMD Ryzen 7 5700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 or AMD RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
